text:
Riya: opening thread for Penumbra POC. customer wants to validate a 13B open model in their VPC for a 10-day POC. goal: conversational assistant with private finetuning.
Ben: quick Q 11 Are they okay with quantized variants or do they insist on fp16?
Riya: preference is cost-sensitive, so propose q8 but keep an fp16 fallback for hallucination-sensitive flows.
Linh: note on runtime compatibility: sticky KV-cache across replicas is required. that means we need persistent cache storage or session-affinity. memory pressure depends on max_seq.
Omar: ask the customer for 95th percentile sequence length. if >1024 we should either increase pod memory or move to fp16.
Riya: sent sample traces earlier today, avg seq ~400, p95 ~900.
Linh: q8 viable. we'll need to upload a quant profile and run kernel validation. also confirm they want Triton vs our native runtime.
Ben: recommend native runtime for q8 on A10g; better throughput and supported optimizations.
SecurityBot: security checklist: customer requires CMK KMS integration, SAML SSO for console, audit log export, and pre-POC data quarantine review.
Omar: legal needs to OK customer-managed KMS flow. also export control questions came up due to customer's industry.
Riya: customer will perform finetuning inside their VPC, they asked that no artifacts leave their environment.
Linh: we can support in-VPC finetune but must disable model telemetry and automatic updates. require runbook for rollback and pinned model hashes.
Ben: ops plan draft: 1) provision 1xA10g with private control plane, 2) deploy pelican-13b-open-q8 artifact, 3) run warmup and perf suite, 4) run 100-case quality eval.
Ben: warmup snippet:
```
./bin/warmup --model pelican-13b-open-q8 --seq 512 --iters 8
```
Riya: acceptance criteria requested by customer: p50 latency <200ms for 256 tokens, p95 <450ms; human pass rate >= 85% vs their baseline.
Finance: cost check: 10-day POC on 1xA10g continuous + storage/monitoring = estimate posted internally. will share public number once approved.
Omar: one blocker: the customer's SIEM only accepts logs via syslog over TLS to a fixed IP. need networking pin.
SecurityBot: that's doable in private deployments; need the architecture diagram and the CIDR/IPs to pre-approve. also confirm whether they want us to manage certificates or they will supply.
Riya: action items: Ben to validate kernel/quant profile compatibility and run perf tests, Linh to draft pinned deployment manifest and KV plan, Omar to shepherd KMS/legal approvals, Finance to provide POC estimate, SecurityBot to send checklist and require architecture diagram by EOD.
Ben: will post perf results to thread and attach memory profiles.
Linh: I'll also run a quick KV-stress with 50 concurrent sessions and share tail latency.
Riya: scheduling a sync with the customer for tomorrow 11am PST. thanks everyone. :rocket:
